pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Atlas is a schema-as-code tool for managing database schemas with declarative HCL or SQL migrations, drift detection, and CI/CD integration for MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and MariaDB.
This package installs Ariga's officially distributed prebuilt Community Edition binary, built from the ariga/atlas GitHub repository under the Apache-2.0 license. It is a reduced feature set compared to dev-db/atlas-msa-bin: no advanced migration commands (checkpoint, down, rebase, edit, rm), no migration/schema linting, no declarative "schema plan"/"schema validate" workflows, no drift detection, no Atlas Registry, and no additional database drivers (SQL Server, ClickHouse, Redshift, Oracle, Snowflake, etc.). See https://atlasgo.io/community-edition for the authoritative feature comparison.
